tool_input.command: sed -i '' 's/if (weightKg < maxWeightKg)/if (weightKg <= maxWeightKg)/' src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs && git diff --stat && cat tests/Storefront.Specs/ShippingCalculatorTests.cs .gitlab-ci.yml && dotnet test 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Restore inclusive bracket bound, view tests and CI config, run tests

result:
- **Cause:** The "Add express shipping" commit refactored the weight brackets into a table and changed the comparison from `<=` to `<`. A parcel of exactly 5 kg fell into the 20 kg bracket (14.90 instead of 7.90); the same was true at exactly 1 kg and 20 kg. It is a real regression, not a runner-02 problem.
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Shipping/ShippingCalculator.cs`, `RateFor` now uses `weightKg <= maxWeightKg` again — a one-character code fix, no test changes. All 42 tests pass locally. The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline stays red until you push it.
